title: You don't have a discipline problem... you have an obedience problem.
paragraphs: You don't have a discipline problem... you have an obedience problem.
That may sound uncomfortable.
But it's also where freedom begins.
Many Christians keep praying for God to change their lives while avoiding the daily habits that God uses to transform them.

We want victory without consistency.
We want spiritual growth without spiritual discipline.
We want the promises of God without the process of God.
If that's been your struggle...

📖 NEW RELEASE
How to Develop Discipline Like a Gospel Warrior for God
This isn't another motivational book.
It's a biblical roadmap to becoming the kind of believer who remains faithful when no one is watching, stands firm in temptation, and develops daily habits that honor Christ.
Because discipline isn't about becoming impressive.
It's about becoming faithful.
Inside this powerful guide, you'll discover:
✅ Why motivation fades—but biblical discipline lasts
✅ How Jesus modeled a life of consistent obedience
✅ Practical habits that strengthen your prayer life and Bible reading
✅ How to overcome procrastination, laziness, and spiritual inconsistency
✅ Biblical strategies to resist temptation and renew your mind
✅ How to finish the race with endurance instead of burning out
✅ Powerful Scriptures, prayers, reflections, and practical action steps
⚔️ MOST PEOPLE vs. FEW PEOPLE
❌ Most people want God to bless their plans.
✅ Few people discipline themselves to obey God's plan.
❌ Most people wait until they "feel" like praying.
✅ Few people seek God whether they feel like it or not.
❌ Most people admire faithful Christians.
✅ Few become one.
The difference isn't talent.
It's daily obedience.
